name: Exploration
summary: The exploration chart for the haunted province of Sylvania. Searching for treasure works as searching for wyrdstone does; only the encounters differ.
income_note: Searching for treasure in Sylvania is the same as searching for wyrdstone; only the encounters differ.

places.name: Well
places.rules:
Select a Hero to check the well and roll a D6:
1 The water teems with giant leeches: roll for injury, treating results of 55 or better as Full Recovery.
2 He meets a man-eating monster in the well: roll for injury, treating results of 55 or better as Full Recovery. If he survives he gains 1 Experience.
3-5 Only a severed head floats in the water; nothing is gained.
6 You find a murdered merchant's body, drained of blood, with one piece of treasure on him.

places.name: Unfriendly Inn
places.rules: You question the men on a successful Leadership roll. This gives the same advantage as tunnels for the next battle.

places.name: Dry Corpse
places.rules:
Roll a D6 to see what you find:
1-2 D6 gc
3 Dagger
4 Axe
5 Sword
6 Light armour

places.name: Terrified Man
places.rules:
Undead warbands bleed him dry and make a new zombie.
Human warbands may roll an extra dice next exploration phase.
Evil warbands sacrifice him and the leader gains 1 Experience.
Skaven gain 2D6 gc by selling him into slavery.

places.name: Abandoned House
places.rules:
Roll a D6:
1 Lucky charm
2 Dagger
3 Crossbow
4 Flail
5 Hooded lantern and rig (see the Grave Robbers equipment list)
6 2D6 gc

places.name: Gallows
places.rules:
A warband may:
Create a zombie (Undead warbands).
Bury the corpse and consecrate the grave (warbands with priests) and gain 1 Experience for the leader.
Cut him down and sell his parts for 2D6 gc (Evil-aligned warbands).

places.name: Pickpocket
places.rules:
A young gypsy boy tries to rob one of the party. Roll a D6:
1 He escapes with 2D6 gc.
2-3 He runs away, leaving his gains behind.
4 You catch him in the act and decide his fate: Undead warbands drain him and create a new zombie; human warbands may recruit him as a Hero on a successful Leadership test if they have a free slot, equipped with 2 daggers and a sling (M 4, WS 2, BS 3, S 3, T 3, W 1, I 4, A 1, Ld 7); Evil warbands sacrifice him and the Leader gains 1 Experience; Skaven can sell him into slavery for 2D6 gc.
5 He escapes, but throws a Lucky Charm one way as he runs the other.
6 His master offers 4D6 gold for his life, unless you would rather take one of the options above.

places.name: Smithy
places.rules:
Roll a D6:
1 Sword
2 Two-handed sword
3 Flail
4 D3 halberds
5 Lance
6 2D6 gc worth of metal

places.name: Prisoners
places.rules:
Vampires find the young women waiting for them and gain D3 zombies.
Human warbands gain D3 Experience, distributed randomly amongst the Heroes.
Evil warbands sacrifice them and gain D3 Experience, distributed randomly amongst the Heroes.
Skaven can sell them into slavery for 6D6 gc.

places.name: Fletcher
places.rules:
Roll a D6:
1-2 D3 short bows
3 D3 bows
4 D3 long bows
5 Quiver of hunting arrows
6 D3 crossbows

places.name: Herbalist
places.rules:
Roll a D6:
1-3 D6 cloves of garlic (not available to the Undead)
4 A dose of crimson shade
5 A dose of mandrake root
6 A dose of healing herbs

places.name: Returning a Favour
places.rules: On a successful Leadership test using your leader's score, you gain the services of a Hired Sword free for the next battle, after which you are liable for his upkeep.

places.name: Gunsmith
places.rules:
Roll a D6:
1 Blunderbuss
2 Brace of pistols
3 Brace of duelling pistols
4 D3 handguns
5 D3 doses of superior blackpowder
6 Hochland long rifle

places.name: Shrine
places.rules:
Undead may try to destroy the shrine to Sigmar: roll against the leader's Leadership. If he passes, gain 3D6 gc; if not, the warband suffers -1 wound for the next battle.
Human warbands may either loot the shrine for 3D6 gc or pray and have one melee weapon blessed so that it gains +1 Strength against the Undead and Possessed.
Evil warbands may defile the shrine and gain 3D6 gc.

places.name: Broken Down Coach
places.rules: You find 3D6 gc.

places.name: Armory
places.rules:
Roll a D6:
1 D3 shields or bucklers (choose which)
2 D3 helmets
3 D3 suits of light armour
4 D3 suits of heavy armour
5 Suit of ithilmar armour
6 A black suit of chainmail. It counts as heavy armour but without the -1 Movement suffered with a shield, and grants the wearer a 6+ save against any magical spell.

places.name: Graveyard
places.rules:
You can loot the graves and gain D6x10 gc.
Vampires or Undead can defile the graves to gain D3 skeletons or zombies instead of looting.
A warband with a priest may consecrate the graves instead and gains D6 Experience, distributed amongst the party.

places.name: Catacombs
places.rules: You may use the tunnels to place up to 3 models anywhere on the battlefield in the next battle, but at least 8" away from enemies. You may place your models after all other models have been placed.

places.name: Gypsy Camp
places.rules:
You may roll for up to three Heroes to consult the fortune teller, each roll costing 5 gc. Roll a D6 for each:
1 Next time he rolls on the injury table, roll twice and choose the lower.
2 Lose 2D6 gc.
3 The prophecy is meaningless; no benefit.
4 He gains +1 Leadership, or +1 Experience if his Leadership is already at its maximum.
5 She gives you a lucky charm.
6 You leave an extra 2D6 gc behind and gain D3+1 Experience.

places.name: Alchemists Workshop
places.rules: Studying the master alchemist's books you find a Surgeon's Journal and 3D6 gc.

places.name: Jewelsmith
places.rules:
Roll a D6:
1-2 Ambers worth D6x5 gc
3-4 Emerald worth 20 gc
5 Necklace worth 50 gc
6 A Star Sapphire worth D6x15 gc. If you do not sell the jewel you can display it as a sign of wealth, adding +1 to all rare trade rolls.

places.name: Merchants House
places.rules: You gain D3 pieces of treasure to sell, and on a roll of 5+ you also find a ledger that gives your Hero the Haggle skill.

places.name: Monastery
places.rules:
Searching the haunted halls you find, rolling a D6:
1-2 D6 vials of holy water
3 A blessed mace, +1 Strength against undead
4 A holy relic
5 D6 vials of tears of Shallya
6 A high priest's holy symbol; the Hero who wears it is immune to Fear caused by undead
A vampire warband instead gains D3 Experience points, distributed as you wish, for desecrating the chapel. An Evil warband may also choose the Experience instead of rolling on the chart.

places.name: Ancient Catacombs
places.rules: From now on you re-roll one exploration dice each post-game sequence.

places.name: A Vampire's Resting Place
places.rules:
You destroy a deeply wounded vampire in his coffin and plunder his tomb. The reward is:
1 Experience for the warband leader
1 Experience for the priest, if the warband has one
D6x10 gc
A jewelled sword 4+
A jewelled dagger 4+
A piece of treasure 5+
A lucky charm 5+
A tome of magic 6+

places.name: Treasure Chest
places.rules:
Roll for each of the following:
5D6x5 gc
D3 pieces of treasure 4+
A holy relic 5+
A suit of heavy armour 5+
D3 gems worth 10 gc each 5+
An elven cloak 5+
A holy tome 5+
A magical artifact 5+
A trap that strikes a random model with a Strength 5 hit 3+

places.name: Dwarven Smithy
places.rules:
Roll a D6:
1 D3 double-handed axes
2 D3 suits of heavy armour
3 Gromril axe
4 Gromril hammer
5 Gromril double-handed axe
6 A suit of Gromril armour

places.name: Old Battlefield
places.rules:
You may scavenge the weapons still in good condition:
3D6x5 gc
D6 daggers
D3 suits of light armour 4+
A suit of heavy armour 4+
Horse barding 5+
D3 halberds 4+
D3 swords 4+
D3 spears 4+
D3 shields 3+
D3 bows 4+
D3 helmets 3+

places.name: The Black Lake
places.rules:
Should a Hero wade into the lake, roll a D6:
1 He is dragged beneath the water. Remove the warrior from your roster.
2 He pulls a golden chalice from the lake-bed, worth 10D6 gc.
3 He recovers D3 pieces of treasure.
4 He receives D3+1 pieces of treasure, 2D6x5 gc and a Star Sapphire worth D6x15 gc. If you do not sell the jewel you can display it as a sign of wealth, adding +1 to all rare trade rolls.
5 A beast in the lake attacks him but is no match for him. The Hero gains 2 Experience and you may re-roll on this table for him, treating another result of 5 as finding nothing.
6 Roll on the Magical Artifacts table.

places.name: The Old Knight
places.rules:
A dying knight hands over a pendant which causes Fear in all undead; its wearer is immune to Fear caused by the Undead.
If you have a Priest in your warband you bury the knight with his belongings (apart from the pendant) and everyone gains +1 Experience, including henchmen groups.
If you have no Priest you may loot him before burying or leaving him. Roll on the following table:
Pendant Auto
D3 daggers 2+
Sword 3+
Bow 5+
Light armour 4+
Heavy armour 5+
Helmet 3+
Shield 3+
Magical Mace (counts as having +1 Strength) 6+
Magical Sword (+2 to the injury roll) 6+
